# `aube cache`

- **Usage:** `aube cache <SUBCOMMAND>`
- **Effect:** read-only

Inspect and manage the packument metadata cache

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube cache path
aube cache view react
```

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/registry-auth) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->
